'''2007 New Jersey State Championship Bill Kafer LS Tatooine: Podrace Arena''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2007 New Jersey State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' Boomrace 3.0 - A
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
